parameters.content:
PURPOSE
Generic public-web discovery using visible n8n HTTP request and branch states.

OWNER
PAOLA TRACK A

INPUT CONTRACT
organization/run context plus query

OUTPUT CONTRACT
source.schema.json[] plus controlled_state

STATUS
Phase 2B repository-ready. Inactive by default. No credentials.

PHASE 2B P0 N8N EXECUTION
Repository-ready n8n implementation for Paola P0 only.
n8n owns the visible execution path and state passing.
21 uses an HTTP Request node against DuckDuckGo Lite HTML with no credentials.
Code nodes are limited to compact deterministic parsing, mapping, retrieval scoring, and validation.
No Python runner is called by n8n. No secrets are stored.

parameters.jsCode: return items.map(item => ({ json: { run_context: item.json.run_context, sources: [], search: item.json.search, controlled_state: 'request_failure', errors: item.json.errors || [{ stage: '21_WEB_SEARCH', message: 'HTTP request failed' }] } }));
return items.map(item => ({ json: { run_context: item.json.run_context, sources: [], search: item.json.search, controlled_state: 'empty_search', errors: item.json.errors || [] } }));

return items.map(item => ({ json: { run_context: item.json.run_context, sources: item.json.sources || [], search: item.json.search, controlled_state: item.json.controlled_state, errors: item.json.errors || [] } }));
